core_obligations: Record that the henselization and strict henselization are Noetherian, so that regularity is defined for them (proof lines 11202-11206).
Choose a minimal system of generators of the maximal ideal of R (proof lines 11206-11209).
Use faithful flatness of the two maps to see that the images of those elements form a minimal system of generators of the extended maximal ideals (proof lines 11209-11215).
Compare the numbers of generators with the dimensions via the cited equality of dimensions and conclude the equivalence (proof lines 11215-11219).
proof_roadmap: Choose a minimal generating system (proof lines 11206-11209).
Transport it by faithful flatness (proof lines 11209-11215).
Compare with dimensions and conclude (proof lines 11215-11220).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that regularity of a Noetherian local ring is equivalent to regularity of its henselization and of its strict henselization, and the proof is a 19-line argument that compares minimal systems of generators. It first notes that the two henselizations are Noetherian so that the statement makes sense, then chooses a minimal system of generators of the maximal ideal of the base, and uses faithful flatness of the two maps to see that the images stay a minimal system of generators of the extended maximal ideals; regularity is then read off from the equality of dimensions already available for henselizations. The faithful flatness step and the dimension comparison are the two ingredients, and both are displayed.
